snippet.title: RIG Riot - Official Launch Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist/Try the Demo on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3180340/RIG_Riot
Download the Demo on Itch: https://sageboatman.itch.io/rig-riot
Support Me on Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/c/SageBoatman
Join the Discord: https://discord.gg/mDqseqTYHH

RIG Riot is a roguelike third-person mech-action shooter. Fight increasingly difficult enemies while completing objectives, level up, and choose the Weapons and Volatile Mods that will let you return from your raids victorious. Discover thousands of permanent parts, and build a RIG unlike any other.

#mech #mecha #mechgames #roguelike #roguelite #steam #indiegame #indiegames #indiedev
